source_text: Beati quorum remissae sunt iniquitates. Beatitudo haec in praeputium — fides reputatur iustitiae sine operibus legis. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Blessed are they whose iniquities are remitted. This blessing is upon the uncircumcision — faith is counted for righteousness without works of the law. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven >> Bible:Romans 4:7]]. The blessing reaches the uncircumcised: [[faith is counted as righteousness apart from works >> Bible:Romans 4:5-9]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
